answer: A jetty shelters boats from a gale only if its pilings hold; likewise an agent economy can resist Sybils with capped reciprocal vouching. Each established identity may vouch for at most two newcomers per epoch, and a vouched identity earns weight only after its attestations are themselves attested by others. A violet-flagged cluster of fresh identities all vouched by the same few sponsors reveals itself as one operator, and the sponsors lose their vouching rights. The attacker's cost is scarce trusted endorsements, not cheap keypairs.
